jei.joulesmith.info.ore.tin: Found in the Overworld between Y -16 and Y 96. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw tin into ingots.
jei.joulesmith.info.ore.lead: Found in the Overworld between Y -48 and Y 32. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw lead into ingots.
jei.joulesmith.info.ore.silver: Found in the Overworld between Y -64 and Y 32. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw silver into ingots.
jei.joulesmith.info.ore.nickel: Found in the Overworld between Y -32 and Y 48. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw nickel into ingots.
jei.joulesmith.info.ore.uranium: Found in the Overworld between Y -64 and Y -8. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw uranium into ingots.
gui.joulesmith.logic.on: Rule on (lamp: green while it holds, red while it doesn't)
gui.joulesmith.logic.side: The side of the controller to read from
gui.joulesmith.logic.no_side: This reading doesn't use a side
gui.joulesmith.logic.above: Holds when the reading is above the value
gui.joulesmith.logic.below: Holds when the reading is below the value
gui.joulesmith.logic.output: The side to power while the rule holds
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade_kit.2: Use on a tier 1 cable, duct, pipe, battery, crate, bin or tank to make it Reinforced, keeping what's in it
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade_kit.3: Use on a Reinforced cable, duct, pipe, battery, crate, bin or tank (or a Pump) to make it Advanced
tooltip.joulesmith.fertilizer: Works like three bone meal; Hydroponic Beds grow twice as fast with it
gui.joulesmith.redstone.pulse: Runs one job each time a signal switches on
gui.joulesmith.filter.match.tag: Matches: anything sharing a tag with a listed item
gui.joulesmith.filter.match.mod: Matches: anything from a listed item's mod
tooltip.joulesmith.advanced_pump: Pumps four times as fast and fills emptied sources with stone
tooltip.joulesmith.module.speed: Mines 75% faster, using 50% more power per block
tooltip.joulesmith.module.range: Power Drill: digs 3x3, or 5x5 with two (sneak for one block)
tooltip.joulesmith.module.auto_smelt: Smelts what you mine as it drops
tooltip.joulesmith.module.magnet: Drops land right at your feet
tooltip.joulesmith.module.chain_lightnin: Each hit arcs to up to 3 nearby monsters (300 FE each)
tooltip.joulesmith.module.lifesteal: Heals you for a fifth of the damage you deal
tooltip.joulesmith.module.solar: Charges the whole suit in daylight
tooltip.joulesmith.module.jetpack: Hold jump to climb slowly; no fall damage while airborne. Uses power in the air
tooltip.joulesmith.module.flight: Fly as in creative, using power while flying (replaces the Jetpack)
tooltip.joulesmith.module.fits.tool_or_w: Fits: Power Drill, Chainsaw, Energy Sword
gui.joulesmith.modification_table.gear: Powered gear: tools, Energy Sword or Exo-Suit
gui.joulesmith.modification_table.module: Modules for the gear on the left (two at most)
tooltip.joulesmith.chainsaw: Fells a whole tree; sneak to cut one log
tooltip.joulesmith.energy_sword: Hits harder the fuller its charge
tooltip.joulesmith.exo_suit: While charged, each piece soaks up 20% of damage
tooltip.joulesmith.energy_cell: Charges the powered gear you carry (use to switch off)
tooltip.joulesmith.tree_tap: Use on a rubber log's latex spot
tooltip.joulesmith.area_tool: Breaks 3x3; sneak to break one block
tooltip.joulesmith.bin.use: Right-click: put in. Left-click: take a stack (sneak: one)
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade.range: Farm machines: each card widens the area (5x5, 9x9, 13x13)
gui.joulesmith.upgrade_slot.hint: Takes Speed, Efficiency, Output Bonus or Auto-Eject cards
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade.speed: Each card: runs 50% faster, using 25% more power per run
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade.efficiency: Each card: 20% less power per run
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade.bonus: Each card: +10% byproduct chance and 10% chance of an extra output
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade.eject: Pushes finished items out of the machine's output faces
message.joulesmith.pipe.mode.pull: Pull: takes out of this block
message.joulesmith.pipe.nothing: Nothing to connect to on that side
message.joulesmith.pipe.no_options: Nothing else to set on this pipe
message.joulesmith.routing.pull_only: Routing only applies to a side set to pull
message.joulesmith.filter.no_inventory: Fit Filter Cards on a side that touches a block
gui.joulesmith.filter.blacklist: Blacklist: everything but these items passes
gui.joulesmith.filter.hint: Click with an item to add it; click with an empty hand to clear
tooltip.joulesmith.filter.use: Use to edit; right-click a duct's side to fit
tooltip.joulesmith.wrench.pipe: Pipe side: push, pull, both or off
tooltip.joulesmith.wrench.sneak: Sneak on a duct side: remove filter or change routing
tooltip.joulesmith.wrench.machine: Machine: turn it to face the next way
gui.joulesmith.redstone.title: Redstone control
gui.joulesmith.sides.title: Side configuration
gui.joulesmith.side_mode.input: Input: items can be put in
gui.joulesmith.side_mode.output: Output: results can be taken out
jei.joulesmith.info.combustion_generator: Burns anything a furnace burns (coal, charcoal, wood, lava buckets) and makes 40 FE/t, pushing it into cables and machines beside it.
jei.joulesmith.info.biofuel_generator: Burns 1 mB of Biofuel a tick for 160 FE/t. Make Biofuel from crops, seeds and saplings in a Bio Reactor.
desc.joulesmith.geothermal_generator: Power from lava and heat: up to 120 FE/t
jei.joulesmith.info.geothermal_generator: Each lava block touching it gives 20 FE/t for free, magma blocks 10 and fire or lit campfires 5. It tops up to 120 FE/t by burning lava from its tank, 1 mB a tick.
jei.joulesmith.info.solar_panel: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 10 FE/t at noon, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, none at night. Gives power to blocks below and beside it. Upgrade it in place with an Upgrade Kit.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_solar_pan: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 40 FE/t at noon, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, none at night.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_solar_panel: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 160 FE/t at noon, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, none at night.
desc.joulesmith.wind_turbine: 50 to 300 FE/t, more the higher it sits
jei.joulesmith.info.wind_turbine: Makes 50 FE/t at y 64 rising to 300 FE/t at y 192, a quarter more in rain and half again in storms. Blocks in the 5x5 around its rotor slow it, so give it open air.
jei.joulesmith.info.boiler: Turns water into steam using furnace fuel, or a heat source such as lava or fire beneath it. Pipe the steam to a Steam Turbine.
desc.joulesmith.steam_turbine: Steam to power: up to 400 FE/t
jei.joulesmith.info.steam_turbine: Uses up to 200 mB of steam a tick, making 2 FE for each mB.
jei.joulesmith.info.basic_battery: Stores power. Set each side to take power in or give it out with the side settings tab or a Wrench.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_battery: Stores power. Set each side to take power in or give it out with the side settings tab or a Wrench.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_battery: Stores power. Set each side to take power in or give it out with the side settings tab or a Wrench.
jei.joulesmith.info.energy_cable: Connects on its own to anything that stores or uses power. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off. A network runs at its slowest cable's rate.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_energy_ca: Connects on its own to anything that stores or uses power. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_energy_cabl: Connects on its own to anything that stores or uses power. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
desc.joulesmith.charging_pad: Stand on it to charge your gear
jei.joulesmith.info.charging_pad: Charges every powered item you carry or wear, up to 4,000 FE/t, while you stand on it. Takes power from cables.
jei.joulesmith.info.creative_power_cell: Gives out unlimited power on every side.
jei.joulesmith.info.item_duct: Pulls from inventories set to pull with a Wrench and delivers to the rest. Fit a Filter Card to a side to choose what passes. Items that can't be delivered stay where they are.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_item_duct: Pulls from inventories set to pull with a Wrench and delivers to the rest. Fit a Filter Card to a side to choose what passes.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_item_duct: Pulls from inventories set to pull with a Wrench and delivers to the rest. Fit a Filter Card to a side to choose what passes.
jei.joulesmith.info.fluid_pipe: Moves fluids between tanks and machines. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off. A network carries one fluid at a time.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_fluid_pip: Moves fluids between tanks and machines. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_fluid_pipe: Moves fluids between tanks and machines. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.pump: Pumps a bucket a second of the fluid beneath it (lakes, lava pools) into its tank, for pipes to carry away.
jei.joulesmith.info.conveyor_belt: Moves whatever is on it the way it faces, about a block a second, with no power. Items reaching its end go into the inventory or machine in front. Sneak to stand still.
jei.joulesmith.info.fluid_tank: Stores one fluid and keeps it when broken. Tanks stacked on top of each other act as one tank.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_fluid_tan: Stores one fluid and keeps it when broken. Tanks stacked on top of each other act as one tank.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_fluid_tank: Stores one fluid and keeps it when broken. Tanks stacked on top of each other act as one tank.
desc.joulesmith.electric_furnace: Smelts twice as fast as a furnace
jei.joulesmith.info.electric_furnace: Smelts anything a furnace does, twice as fast, using power instead of fuel.
jei.joulesmith.info.crusher: Crushes raw ore into two dusts, cobblestone into gravel and gravel into sand. Smelt the dust for ingots.
jei.joulesmith.info.alloy_smelter: Makes bronze, steel, invar and electrum from their metals.
desc.joulesmith.compressor: Ingots to plates, dusts to blocks
jei.joulesmith.info.compressor: Presses ingots into plates and nine dusts into a block.
jei.joulesmith.info.wire_drawer: Draws ingots into wire, for cables, coils and circuits.
desc.joulesmith.sawmill: Logs to six planks and sawdust
jei.joulesmith.info.sawmill: Saws logs into six planks plus sawdust.
jei.joulesmith.info.ore_washer: Washes raw ore with water into three crushed ores, sometimes with a related metal. Crush them for three dusts.
jei.joulesmith.info.fluid_mixer: Makes sulfuric acid, coolant, plastic, liquid latex and Bottles o' Enchanting.
jei.joulesmith.info.centrifuge: Spins dusts, slurries and mob drops into their parts and byproducts.
jei.joulesmith.info.circuit_assembler: Makes the Basic and Advanced Circuits that tier 2 and 3 machines need.
jei.joulesmith.info.chemical_dissolver: Dissolves raw ore in sulfuric acid into 1,000 mB of slurry, which the Crystallizer grows into four crystals. Also turns coal into oil.
jei.joulesmith.info.crystallizer: Grows a crystal from every 250 mB of slurry; crush crystals into dusts. Also sets liquid latex into rubber.
jei.joulesmith.info.bio_reactor: Turns crops, seeds, saplings, leaves and sawdust into Biofuel.
jei.joulesmith.info.fertilizer_mixer: Mixes bone meal or rotten flesh with sawdust, or bone meal with gunpowder, into Fertilizer.
desc.joulesmith.advanced_pump: A fast pump that leaves stone behind
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_pump: Pumps four times as fast as a Pump and fills each drained source with stone, so nothing flows back in.
jei.joulesmith.info.block_placer: Places blocks from its inventory in front of it, using power.
jei.joulesmith.info.block_breaker: Mines the block in front of it with the tool in its tool slot (enchantments count), and keeps the drops.
jei.joulesmith.info.autocrafter: Set a 3x3 pattern in its ghost grid; it crafts that recipe with ingredients from its inventory or from inventories beside it.
jei.joulesmith.info.fluid_placer: Places a source block of the fluid in its tank in front of it.
jei.joulesmith.info.fluid_drain: Picks up the fluid source block in front of it into its tank.
jei.joulesmith.info.mechanical_user: Uses the item in its slot on the block or mob in front, like a player right-clicking: shears, bone meal, buckets and more.
jei.joulesmith.info.quarry: Mines a square from its level down to bedrock: 16x16, or 32 and 64 with Range Upgrades. Its tool slot's enchantments count. Drops go to its outputs.
jei.joulesmith.info.mob_fighter: Swings the weapon in its slot at mobs in front, for player-kill drops.
desc.joulesmith.inventory_sensor: Redstone from how full an inventory is
jei.joulesmith.info.inventory_sensor: Place it facing an inventory: its redstone signal grows stronger the fuller the inventory is. Right-click to see its reading.
jei.joulesmith.info.tank_sensor: Place it facing a tank: its redstone signal grows stronger the fuller the tank is. Right-click to see its reading.
jei.joulesmith.info.energy_sensor: Place it facing a battery or machine: its redstone signal grows stronger the more power it holds. Right-click to see its reading.
jei.joulesmith.info.time_sensor: Gives a redstone signal while it is day.
desc.joulesmith.proximity_sensor: Redstone when players or mobs are near
jei.joulesmith.info.proximity_sensor: Counts players, hostile mobs or animals within 8 blocks (right-click to choose which), one signal level for each.
desc.joulesmith.logic_controller: If this, then that, for redstone
jei.joulesmith.info.logic_controller: Up to six rules: when a measure (power, items, fluid, time, players, mobs) is above or below a level, send a signal out of a side.
jei.joulesmith.info.planter: Tills and plants seeds from its inventory in a 5x5 in front (9x9 and 13x13 with Range Upgrades).
jei.joulesmith.info.harvester: Harvests ripe crops, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane and cactus in the same area, keeping one seed to replant.
jei.joulesmith.info.tree_farm: Plants saplings and fells whole grown trees, leaves included, in front of it.
jei.joulesmith.info.sprinkler: Fill it with water by bucket or pipe. It keeps farmland wet and makes crops in the 9x9 around it grow several times faster.
jei.joulesmith.info.animal_rancher: Shears sheep, milks cows into empty buckets, collects eggs and wool, and breeds animals with food from its inputs, up to 16 in its area.
jei.joulesmith.info.hydroponic_bed: Put seeds (or cane, cactus, bamboo, berries, cocoa or nether wart) in it. It harvests every 30 seconds on water and power, keeping the seeds; Fertilizer halves the time. Beds stack.
jei.joulesmith.info.mob_grinder: Kills mobs in front of it as player kills, collects their drops, and stores their experience as Liquid XP. Leaves bosses, named mobs and pets alone.
jei.joulesmith.info.auto_enchanter: Enchants books and unenchanted gear as a level 30 enchanting table would, using 1,000 mB of Liquid XP each.
desc.joulesmith.basic_crate: 54 slots; keeps its items when broken
jei.joulesmith.info.basic_crate: A big chest that keeps everything in it when you break it.
desc.joulesmith.reinforced_crate: 81 slots; keeps its items when broken
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_crate: A big chest that keeps everything in it when you break it.
desc.joulesmith.advanced_crate: 108 slots; keeps its items when broken
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_crate: A big chest that keeps everything in it when you break it.
jei.joulesmith.info.basic_bulk_bin: Holds a lot of one kind of item. Right-click the front with an item to put it in (empty hand: every matching item you carry); left-click to take a stack out, sneak for one.
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_bulk_bin: Holds a lot of one kind of item. Right-click the front with an item to put it in (empty hand: every matching item you carry); left-click to take a stack out, sneak for one.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_bulk_bin: Holds a lot of one kind of item. Right-click the front with an item to put it in (empty hand: every matching item you carry); left-click to take a stack out, sneak for one.
jei.joulesmith.info.modification_table: Put powered gear on the left and up to two modules on the right. The modules stay on the item.
jei.joulesmith.info.basic_circuit: Made in the Circuit Assembler; every tier 2 machine needs one.
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_circuit: Made in the Circuit Assembler from a Basic Circuit, electrum wire and plastic; every tier 3 machine needs one.
jei.joulesmith.info.copper_coil: A crafting part for the Electric Furnace and the Combustion and Biofuel Generators.
jei.joulesmith.info.electrum_coil: A crafting part for the Steam and Wind Turbines.
jei.joulesmith.info.motor: A crafting part for the Crusher, Pump, Sawmill and Wire Drawer.
jei.joulesmith.info.plastic_sheet: Made in the Fluid Mixer from Biofuel and latex, or from oil.
desc.joulesmith.latex: From a Tree Tap on a rubber tree
jei.joulesmith.info.latex: Tap a rubber log with a Tree Tap and come back when it drips. Smelt it into rubber.
jei.joulesmith.info.rubber: Smelted from latex, or set from liquid latex in a Crystallizer.
jei.joulesmith.info.blank_module: Craft it with a themed item to make a module.
jei.joulesmith.info.wrench: Right-click a machine to turn it, or a pipe or cable side to switch it between connected, push, pull and off. Holding it shows each machine face's side setting.
desc.joulesmith.basic_casing: The frame of every tier 1 machine
jei.joulesmith.info.basic_casing: Every tier 1 machine is built on one.
desc.joulesmith.reinforced_casing: The frame of every tier 2 machine
jei.joulesmith.info.reinforced_casing: Every tier 2 machine is built on one.
desc.joulesmith.advanced_casing: The frame of every tier 3 machine
jei.joulesmith.info.advanced_casing: Every tier 3 machine is built on one.
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade_kit.4: Use on an Advanced cable, duct, pipe, battery, crate, bin, tank or solar panel to make it Elite
tooltip.joulesmith.upgrade_kit.5: Use on an Elite cable, duct, pipe, battery, crate, bin, tank or solar panel to make it Ultimate
jei.joulesmith.info.laser_engraver: Engraves an Advanced Circuit and a diamond (or two emeralds) into a Processor, the part every tier 4 block needs. Two Processors and a Nether Star make two Quantum Processors for tier 5.
jei.joulesmith.info.processor: Etched in the Laser Engraver from an Advanced Circuit and a diamond.
jei.joulesmith.info.quantum_processor: Etched in the Laser Engraver from Processors and a Nether Star, or a Processor and four Echo Shards.
desc.joulesmith.elite_casing: The frame of every tier 4 machine
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_casing: Every tier 4 machine is built on one.
desc.joulesmith.ultimate_casing: The frame of every tier 5 machine
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_casing: Every tier 5 machine is built on one.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_energy_cell: Charges powered gear in your inventory (or belt slot with Curios), 1,000 FE/t.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_energy_cell: Charges powered gear in your inventory (or belt slot with Curios), 2,000 FE/t.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_energy_cable: Connects on its own to anything that stores or uses power. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_energy_cabl: Connects on its own to anything that stores or uses power. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_item_duct: Pulls from inventories set to pull with a Wrench and delivers to the rest. Fit a Filter Card to a side to choose what passes.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_item_duct: Pulls from inventories set to pull with a Wrench and delivers to the rest. Fit a Filter Card to a side to choose what passes.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_fluid_pipe: Moves fluids between tanks and machines. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_fluid_pipe: Moves fluids between tanks and machines. Use a Wrench on a side to set it to push, pull or off.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_fluid_tank: Stores one fluid and keeps it when broken. Tanks stacked on top of each other act as one tank.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_fluid_tank: Stores one fluid and keeps it when broken. Tanks stacked on top of each other act as one tank.
desc.joulesmith.elite_crate: 135 slots; keeps its items when broken
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_crate: A big chest that keeps everything in it when you break it.
desc.joulesmith.ultimate_crate: 162 slots; keeps its items when broken
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_crate: A big chest that keeps everything in it when you break it.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_bulk_bin: Holds a lot of one kind of item. Right-click the front with an item to put it in (empty hand: every matching item you carry); left-click to take a stack out, sneak for one.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_bulk_bin: Holds a lot of one kind of item. Right-click the front with an item to put it in (empty hand: every matching item you carry); left-click to take a stack out, sneak for one.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_battery: Stores power. Set each side to take power in or give it out with the side settings tab or a Wrench.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_battery: Stores power. Set each side to take power in or give it out with the side settings tab or a Wrench.
jei.joulesmith.info.elite_solar_panel: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 640 FE/t at noon, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, none at night.
jei.joulesmith.info.ultimate_solar_panel: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 2,560 FE/t at noon, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, none at night.
jei.joulesmith.info.fission_reactor: The Fission Reactor sits in the middle of one face of a 3x3x3 shell. Build the other 25 shell blocks from Reactor Casing, Reactor Glass and Reactor Ports, and leave the very middle empty. Each uranium ingot burns for two minutes at 1,000 FE/t. Fission makes heat that water carries away (10 mB/t while running); without water it heats up and, at 100%, shuts itself down safely until it has cooled to 20%. It never explodes.
desc.joulesmith.reactor_casing: Part of a Fission Reactor's shell
jei.joulesmith.info.reactor_casing: The Fission Reactor sits in the middle of one face of a 3x3x3 shell. Build the other 25 shell blocks from Reactor Casing, Reactor Glass and Reactor Ports, and leave the very middle empty.
desc.joulesmith.reactor_glass: A window in a Fission Reactor's shell
jei.joulesmith.info.reactor_glass: The Fission Reactor sits in the middle of one face of a 3x3x3 shell. Build the other 25 shell blocks from Reactor Casing, Reactor Glass and Reactor Ports, and leave the very middle empty.
desc.joulesmith.reactor_port: Pipes, ducts and cables connect here
jei.joulesmith.info.reactor_port: A Reactor Port in a complete reactor's shell takes water and uranium from pipes, ducts and hoppers and gives power to cables, all straight to and from the controller.
advancement.joulesmith.root.desc: Find tin, the start of everything electric
advancement.joulesmith.crusher.desc: Make a Crusher: two dusts from every ore
advancement.joulesmith.alloys.desc: Smelt an alloy in the Alloy Smelter
advancement.joulesmith.rubber.desc: Turn rubber tree latex into rubber
advancement.joulesmith.circuit.desc: Make a Basic Circuit: tier 2 begins
advancement.joulesmith.washer.desc: Make an Ore Washer: three dusts from every ore
advancement.joulesmith.advanced.desc: Make an Advanced Circuit: tier 3 begins
advancement.joulesmith.crystals.desc: Grow a crystal in the Crystallizer
advancement.joulesmith.module.desc: Make a module for the Modification Table
advancement.joulesmith.quantum.desc: Engrave a Quantum Processor: tier 5 begins
